summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience designing, coding, and enhancing front-end components for data-intensive systems using React.js and TypeScript. Strong background in component-based architecture and state management (Redux, Redux-Saga, Context API), REST and GraphQL API integration, and OAuth2/OIDC authentication flows. Proven experience building dashboard-style enterprise applications — including a React/Redux Toolkit analytics platform that turned large-scale datamarts into actionable visualizations for business stakeholders — along with role-based UI behavior, form validation, and error/loading-state handling for production-grade products. Skilled in Agile delivery, UI test automation (Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines, with a track record leading engineering teams of 5–10, mentoring junior developers, and driving best practices to improve software quality and delivery.

_skill_levels._note: expert = 3+ yrs production use; proficient = 1–3 yrs; familiar = used but not primary. Used by ranker to weight skill matches.

experience.title: Software Developer – DataPower UI
highlights: Implemented a scalable, high-performing modern UI for IBM DataPower: a Single Page Application (SPA) and REST API architecture with 50–80 views, leveraging TypeScript, React, Express.js, and the Carbon Design System.
Collaborated with backend, design, and QA teams to deliver UI/UX solutions resulting in a 4x improvement in page rendering performance compared to the legacy UI.
Led the support initiative — triaging and debugging customer issues within the squad, reducing response times from several days to hours.

Secured user authentication by integrating OIDC login and role-based access control; fully migrated AAA User Onboarding to React, eliminating security vulnerabilities and dependency on the legacy stack.
Served as security focal point for DataPower UIs — addressed issues identified through SAST, DAST, and Mend security scans by analysing vulnerabilities and implementing fixes.
Wrote 100+ automated Cypress tests for front-end components to ensure code quality, reduce defects, and support continuous integration.

experience.title: Senior Engineering Management Specialist
highlights: Led front-end engineering teams of 5–10 across concurrent React/TypeScript client engagements, delivering production releases via AWS Amplify CI/CD pipelines while mentoring 3–4 interns/engineers and leading React training tracks.
Raised code quality and cut defect rates by 80% across projects via ESLint-driven PR review standards, Jest-based unit testing, and reusable component-driven React libraries adopted by 3–4 teams.

Clear Carbon (US client): Architected the service layer and ESLint standards from scratch for a carbon-credit trading platform, using Webpack for build configuration and Axios for RESTful API integration, with Jest-based test coverage from day one.

Profitability Analytics Tool (Tech Architect): Built a React, AWS, and Redux Toolkit application from the ground up, integrating GraphQL and React Query (TanStack Query) for efficient data fetching and caching, turning large-scale datamarts into actionable visualizations for business stakeholders.
Tangra (ICP): Delivered a multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) landing-zone platform via AWS Amplify CI/CD pipeline, Micro-Frontends architecture, and SAST/DAST security onboarding on Deloitte platform.

Sorted Services, Mfine & LOLC: Shipped Referral Landlord Portal (React, Redux-Saga, Context API, Formik) with positive Phase-I client feedback; integrated healthcare platform into Flipkart and Google Pay mini-app ecosystems; delivered permissions-based Auth0-to-AWS OAuth migration POC in one month.
